entities.summary: Pavlo Vyshebaba (b. 1986-03-28, Kramatorsk) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kramatorsk and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
